bug_info.bug_desc: In keymgr_dpe.sv, invalid_data[OpAdvance] was computed only from ~key_vld and ~adv_dvalid[active_key_slot.boot_stage]. The controller's broader advance-invalidity conditions (policy disallows child, max boot stage reached, source slot invalid, or retain_parent/destination rule violated) were used to reject the operation but were not forwarded to the KMAC input validity path. As a result, an advance request that was invalid for one of those reasons while the selected slot secret and stage-specific message data happened to be individually valid could send the real advance message payload to KMAC instead of randomized/invalid data, even though the operation should be rejected.
bug_info.fix_hint: Expose the controller's request-independent advance-invalidity condition as invalid_advance_o from invalid_allow_child, invalid_max_boot_stage, invalid_src_slot, and invalid_retain_parent, and OR it into invalid_data[OpAdvance] in the top module so that any invalid advance command also marks the KMAC message payload invalid/randomized.
